info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Airline Flights Baggages-v5-spec
info.description: The Airline Baggage Retrieval API facilitates the acquisition of baggage-related information for airline flights. This endpoint allows users to obtain details such as baggage allowances, status, and additional policies associated with specific flights. Key consumers include airline personnel, customer service agents, and travel applications that assist travelers with baggage management. By utilizing this API, customers can enhance their travel experience through informed baggage handling and support.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to access detailed baggage information related to specific flights, including baggage status, weight limits, and any additional fees that may apply.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve baggage information related to flights. It should contain relevant flight details to ensure accurate baggage information is fetched.
